claims.subject: pintle tip blockage factor
claims.predicate: was advised by TRW (via Escher) as
claims.statement: According to Escher's personal correspondence with TRW, the company advised pintle tips with 0.3 < BF < 0.7; Freeberg selected its tips within this range (BF 0.35, 0.45, 0.55 circular; 0.6 and 0.55 rectangular).
qualifiers: second-hand: TRW advice relayed through Escher's personal correspondence; water cold-flow study
claims.quote: the use of pintle tips with 0.3 < BF < 0.7
